label: Every ESSENCE_5 truth holds at the actual world
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: factivity of ESSENCE_5 at the actual world. For every being x and world-proposition φ, if it lies in the nature of x that φ, then φ holds at w. What lies in a nature is true. It follows from 'essence grounds necessity' (EssenceGroundsNecessity) on a frame reflexive at w.
